verdict: Design-first everyday Swiss automatic with real-world fit trade-offs.

insights.label: Design + originality
insights.headline: Familiar does not automatically mean derivative.
insights.text: The PRX scores strongly for visual coherence and own-lineage originality. Its modern integrated-bracelet identity traces back to Tissot's own 1978 design language.

insights.label: Movement
insights.headline: 80 hours is useful — but it is not the whole movement.
insights.text: The long reserve changes real ownership behaviour. The full movement score stays in the high 70s because accuracy, architecture and serviceability are solid rather than exceptional.

insights.label: Wearability
insights.headline: 40 mm is not the whole fit story.
insights.text: Integrated first links push effective wrist span to roughly 51.5 mm, so the watch can wear broader than its nominal diameter suggests and offers less strap flexibility.
